raw_comment:
1. The graph shows the drought distribution in the US. I notice that the middle area of the United States is approximately more extreme than others. In addition, I see that most of the area has drought and lack of water. 
2. I wonder why the middle part has more drought than California because California has lots of wildfires but is at the stage of abnormally dry, it's not extreme.
3. This relates to my community because it gives a sense that the United States lacks water.

The Urgency of Water in America
